# RUN22 vendored changes

All source below is borrowed from openai/codex@8801b9a8a6c606508736d4e01dedabe52833d637, Apache-2.0. The pinned source mirror omits the codex-rs directory prefix. Destination paths restore it. No upstream crate or protocol is imported.

- LICENSE from V/LICENSE: unchanged.
- NOTICE from V/NOTICE: unchanged.
- codex-rs/utils/pty/src/process_group.rs from V/utils/pty/src/process_group.rs: retain header and Linux worker group creation, parent death signal and group TERM/KILL functions. Omit other platforms, PTY/session helpers, Tokio Child adapters and upstream tests. Use std child in our controller.
- codex-rs/utils/pty/src/linux_fds.rs from V/utils/pty/src/linux_fds.rs: retain header and close-on-exec cleanup including proc fallback. Replace edition 2024 let chain with Option combinators for edition 2021. Propagate descriptor cleanup and proc enumeration errors to pre_exec instead of the upstream best-effort behavior, so a cleanup failure prevents worker exec. Retain the upstream header and explicitly note this policy change below it. Omit external upstream test module; local worker tests cover inheritance.
- codex-rs/process-hardening/src/lib.rs from V/process-hardening/src/lib.rs: extract disable_process_dumping and core size limit only. Return io errors instead of printing or exiting. No router pre-main hook, environment mutation or platform scaffolding. Dumpability applies before exec; the core size limit persists across exec.
- codex-rs/utils/head-tail-buffer/src/lib.rs from V/utils/head-tail-buffer/src/lib.rs: retain upstream header, byte retention algorithm and its self-contained omission marker (no output-truncation file needed). Replace the const generic with a runtime capacity and explicit constructor; use a rest pattern for unused destructured fields. Omit unused buffer merging and accounting accessors plus the external test module; local tests cover real pipe capture. Payload cap excludes the bounded omission notice.
- codex-rs/secrets/src/sanitizer.rs from V/secrets/src/sanitizer.rs: production implementation unchanged; no upstream tests or fixtures copied. Local adapters sanitize complete bounded lines before truncation and event string values before serialization. Oversized lines are wholly elided with a public marker so chunk boundaries cannot expose partial matches. regex was already in Cargo.lock; no package was added.
